scenarios.note: The server still answers, but sends no CORS header, so browsers will not let that page read the response.

scenarios.label: Too many requests
scenarios.note: Limit shown is 2 per minute so the demo is short. The default is 100 per minute.

scenarios.label: Handler never responds
scenarios.note: Timeout shown is 50 ms for the demo. The default is 30 seconds.

scenarios.label: Oversized body
scenarios.request: POST /users  5 kB body (limit set to 1 kB)
scenarios.note: Limit shown is 1 kB for the demo. The default is 100 kb.

scenarios.label: Prototype pollution payload
scenarios.note: Bodies with __proto__, constructor or prototype keys are rejected before your code sees them.

scenarios.label: Invalid input
scenarios.note: validate(schema) on the route returns every problem in one response.

scenarios.label: Unhandled exception
scenarios.request: GET /crash  (handler throws with a database password in the message)
scenarios.note: In production the message is replaced. The full error goes to the log, not the client.
